name: Hotpoint HDM67V8D2CX/UK — 60cm Freestanding Cooker

description: The Hotpoint HDM67V8D2CX is a 60cm freestanding electric cooker in inox with two full fan ovens (70L main + 44L top, 114L total) and Multiflow technology for even results across up to five dishes at once. A steam function keeps bakes and roasts succulent, catalytic liners cut down cleaning, and a double display lets you run both ovens independently. A energy rated.
